mapper.select: SELECT TOP 50 MATERIAL_ID AS ITEM_SEQ, MATERIAL_CODE AS ITEM_NO, MATERIAL_NAME AS ITEM_NAME, MATERIAL_SPEC AS ITEM_SPEC FROM TCO403 WHERE FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} AND ISNULL(DELETE_FLAG, '') != '1' AND ( MATERIAL_ID LIKE '%' + #{keyword} + '%' OR MATERIAL_CODE LIKE '%' + #{keyword} + '%' OR MATERIAL_NAME LIKE '%' + #{keyword} + '%' ) ORDER BY MATERIAL_CODE
